document.about: Bosch Sensortec BME280 sensor datasheet (60 pages): shaded two-column tables, a header row of words over a column of figures.

checks.issue: Table 13 (page 22) is two columns ruled alike, its header row set like the rows under it. It was read as a list of fields: `Temperature | Typical change in noise compared to 25 °C` became a row, and the percentages had no column name.
